summary: Fresh execution attempt parented to a failed run.
description: A retry re-drains the plan as a brand-new execution parented to the failed one (Retry-as-New-Attempt; mirrors internal/execution/retry.go). It is never an in-place mutation of the prior run.

inputs.name: RETRY_NOTE
inputs.description: Optional operator note carried into the retry as follow-up context.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: Structured handoff: summary, blockers, next step, changed files, tests. The single artifact the next round consumes and the classifier derives progress from.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: Routing signal derived from the handoff: continue (another round is warranted), complete (the operation's unit of work is done), or blocked (needs operator attention).

outcomes.name: completed
outcomes.description: The operation's unit of work finished; the workflow advances (e.g. opens review).

outcomes.name: continue
outcomes.description: Another round of the same operation is warranted; the loop continues.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.description: Progress is blocked; the round parks for operator attention.

outcomes.name: needs-attention
outcomes.description: The classifier could not derive an honest outcome; the round abstains to operator attention.
